name: ThemeColorScheme
description: Represents the color scheme of a Microsoft Office theme.
example:
Dim tTheme As OfficeTheme
Dim tcsThemeColorScheme As ThemeColorScheme
Set tcsThemeColorScheme = tTheme.ThemeColorScheme

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Gets an Application object that represents the container application for the ThemeColorScheme object. Read-only.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Gets a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the ThemeColorScheme object was created. Read-only.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Gets the Parent object for the ThemeColorScheme object. Read-only.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Gets an Integer indicating the number of items in the ThemeColorScheme collection. Read-only.

methods.name: Colors
methods.description: Gets an object that represents a color in the color scheme of a Microsoft Office theme.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: The index value of the ThemeColor object.

methods.name: Load
methods.description: Loads the color scheme of a Microsoft Office theme from a file.

parameters.name: FileName
parameters.description: The name of the color theme file.

methods.name: Save
methods.description: Saves the color scheme of a Microsoft Office theme to a file.

methods.name: GetCustomColor
methods.description: Gets a value that represents a color in the color scheme of a Microsoft Office theme.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the custom color.
